questions.concept: What is the difference between a loop and a graph in the context of agents?
questions.stem: What is the difference between a loop and a graph in the context of agents?
options: Loops are for small tasks, graphs are for large tasks
Loops are controlled by the model, graphs are controlled by the code
Loops are for single agents, graphs are for multiple agents
Loops are for feedback, graphs are for checks
questions.source_quote: Loop: one agent inside one feedback loop. You give Claude Code a goal and a check, and it keeps going until the check passes. The model chooses every step in between. Graph: the work is split into steps that your code wires together. Plan first, implement the pieces in parallel with separate agents, review, send back only what failed, then merge.
